# superset_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a dashboard. The charts shown on the dashboard are the charts placed in its `position_json`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard" "signups" {
  title     = "Signups"
  slug      = "signups"
  published = true
  roles     = [superset_role.analysts.id]

  json_metadata = jsonencode({
    refresh_frequency = 300
    color_scheme      = "supersetColors"
  })

  # The layout places the chart on the dashboard and links it to the dashboard.
  position_json = jsonencode({
    DASHBOARD_VERSION_KEY = "v2"
    ROOT_ID               = { type = "ROOT", id = "ROOT_ID", children = ["GRID_ID"] }
    GRID_ID               = { type = "GRID", id = "GRID_ID", parents = ["ROOT_ID"], children = ["ROW-1"] }
    "ROW-1" = {
      type     = "ROW"
      id       = "ROW-1"
      parents  = ["ROOT_ID", "GRID_ID"]
      children = ["CHART-1"]
      meta     = { background = "BACKGROUND_TRANSPARENT" }
    }
    "CHART-1" = {
      type     = "CHART"
      id       = "CHART-1"
      parents  = ["ROOT_ID", "GRID_ID", "ROW-1"]
      children = []
      meta     = { chartId = superset_chart.daily_signups.id, width = 6, height = 50 }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Title of the dashboard.

### Optional

- `certification_details` (String) Details of the certification.
- `certified_by` (String) Person or group that certified the dashboard.
- `css` (String) CSS applied to the dashboard.
- `json_metadata` (String) JSON document with the settings of the dashboard, such as `refresh_frequency`, `color_scheme` or `native_filter_configuration`. Only the keys set here are managed: keys Superset adds or that are changed in the UI keep their value and are not reported as drift. When unset, the settings are left to Superset.
- `owners` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the users who own the dashboard. Defaults to the user the provider authenticates as.
- `position_json` (String) JSON document with the layout of the dashboard. The charts referenced by its `CHART` elements are linked to the dashboard. Superset adds the `uuid` of each chart to the layout, which is not reported as drift. When unset, the layout is left to Superset.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is published; an unpublished dashboard is a draft visible to its owners only. Defaults to `false`.
- `roles` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the roles granted access to the dashboard when dashboard role-based access control is enabled.
- `slug` (String) Unique slug used in the URL of the dashboard instead of its id.
- `tags` (Set of String) Names of the tags attached to the dashboard, with the `TAGGING_SYSTEM` feature flag. When unset, the tags are left as they are; when set, the dashboard has exactly these tags. Tags that do not exist yet are created, and stay when the dashboard is destroyed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dashboard.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Dashboards are imported by their numeric id.
terraform import superset_dashboard.signups 17
```
